scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by generous space.

LEFT ZONE, from offer to charter: at the top a small gift box with a tag showing only a person silhouette (no text on the tag), labelled OFFER: A PERSON, NOT THE WORK. A navy arrow points down from it to a larger clipboard charter document below. The charter has a header strip labelled CHARTER and three rows, each a small icon followed by its label: a target icon, labelled RESULT: ONE REPEATABLE SETUP PATH; a specialist figure with a coin stack, labelled 10 SPECIALIST DAYS, €15K CAP; an engineer at a laptop, labelled 6 ENGINEER-DAYS.

MIDDLE ZONE, one single straight horizontal timeline with three milestones, left to right: a person arriving with a toolbox, labelled DAY 21: START; a signpost whose arrow turns from a gear towards a messy stack of customer records under a magnifying glass, labelled WEEK 3: REDIRECT TO DATA CHECK; an engineer and a customer-team member working at a laptop while the specialist stands behind them with arms folded, only watching, labelled WEEK 6: HANDOVER TEST.

RIGHT ZONE, three good endings stacked vertically, each a teal-outlined box with one icon and a small ochre check mark: a wrench held by a company worker, labelled CAPABILITY; a lightbulb over a board table, labelled BETTER DECISION; a service desk with a clearly visible price tag with no text, labelled UNDERSTOOD SERVICE. Below them, separated, a grey box with a chain and padlock tied to a person, crossed out with a thin navy line, labelled UNPLANNED DEPENDENCY.

All papers, tags and screens are blank or show only wavy lines; no digits except in the labels.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: OFFER: A PERSON, NOT THE WORK, CHARTER, RESULT: ONE REPEATABLE SETUP PATH, 10 SPECIALIST DAYS, €15K CAP, 6 ENGINEER-DAYS, DAY 21: START, WEEK 3: REDIRECT TO DATA CHECK, WEEK 6: HANDOVER TEST, CAPABILITY, BETTER DECISION, UNDERSTOOD SERVICE, UNPLANNED DEPENDENCY. Any other text is a defect.
alt: An offer that names a person but not the work becomes a charter with one repeatable setup path as its result, ten specialist days capped at €15,000 and six engineer-days; a timeline shows the specialist starting on day 21, the work redirected to a data check at week three and a handover test at week six; three good endings, a capability, a better decision and an understood service, stand beside a crossed-out unplanned dependency.
caption: Write down the result and both sides’ resources, let the evidence redirect the work, and end with something the company can use.
